# diyaz.

> Personal portfolio and technical blog of Diyaz Yakubov — software engineer, full-stack developer, and founder based in Helsinki, Finland.

## About

Diyaz Yakubov is a software engineer with 10+ years of experience building scalable web applications, distributed systems, and cloud-native solutions. He holds a Master's degree in Software Engineering from Tampere University (Finland) and a Bachelor's in Computer Engineering from EKSTU (Kazakhstan). He is the founder of TopTop.dev, a software development company serving SMBs in the Nordic region.

Expertise below is generated from _data/profile.yml, the same source about.html
renders its skills grid and expertise tags from. Previously maintained by hand
here and drifted — it omitted AI Engineering, Event Storming, Python and FastAPI
long after about.html listed them.
{% endcomment -%}

{% comment %}
Project sections below are generated from _data/projects.yml, the same source
projects.html renders. Each item uses its `summary` field (the terse one-liner)
rather than `description` (the long page copy), and links to its first entry.

Headings are derived from the data rather than hardcoded, so a group with a new
llms_section shows up here automatically instead of silently vanishing. A group
with no llms_section is deliberately excluded.
{% endcomment -%}
{%- assign llms_sections = site.data.projects | map: "llms_section" | compact | uniq -%}
{%- for ls in llms_sections -%}
{%- comment -%}
  Count first. Emitting the heading before knowing whether any item follows
  leaves a bare "## Section" behind when a group is scaffolded with items: [].
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign section_items = 0 -%}
{%- for group in site.data.projects -%}
{%- if group.llms_section == ls and group.items -%}
{%- assign section_items = section_items | plus: group.items.size -%}
{%- endif -%}
{%- endfor -%}
{%- if section_items > 0 %}## {{ ls }}
{% for group in site.data.projects %}{% if group.llms_section == ls %}{% if group.llms_format == 'inline' %}
{% for item in group.items %}{{ item.name }} ({{ item.description }}){% unless forloop.last %}, {% endunless %}{% endfor %}{% else %}{% for item in group.items %}
- {% if item.links %}[{{ item.name }}]({{ item.links.first.url }}){% else %}{{ item.name }}{% endif %}{% if item.summary %}: {{ item.summary }}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}

{% endif -%}
{%- endfor -%}
## Blog Topics

Technical deep-dives covering AI engineering and LLM tooling, developer productivity systems, .NET and React, WebAssembly, memory management, cloud and edge computing, speculative design, and DIY maker projects.
